clone_prestaged.label: duplicação com criativos novos
replace: ads/creatives with approved reconciled pre-staged media
copy only when explicitly supplied and approved
clone_prestaged.ads: one through five, matching the approved request

clone_page_switch.label: duplicação com troca de página
replace: pg_XXXXX and destination tracking only when confirmed
complete Messenger JSON for the target Page

from_zero_prestaged.label: criação do zero com criativos novos pre-stageados
from_zero_prestaged.ads: exactly three or five per campaign
from_zero_prestaged.default_status: ACTIVE with future next-day 00:00 America/New_York start_time after final approval
from_zero_prestaged.budget: manager-selected input; write remains gated by Rodolfo/Geizian
from_zero_prestaged.naming: [page sequence] - [Page] - ENG - US - (pg_XXXXX) C0XX para [Page first name] - Copy
from_zero_prestaged.placements: manual operation payload; Audience Network forbidden
from_zero_prestaged.copy_template: Jolie C001 reference fields with later operation flags taking precedence

naming_policy.rule: preserve the original campaign base name and append DUPnn
naming_policy.duplicate_of_duplicate: strip the trailing DUPnn to recover the same base and use the next number
examples: Original Campaign DUP01 -> Original Campaign DUP02
naming_policy.collision_gate: read all non-deleted live campaign names and select the first free sequential DUP number before manifest sealing

budget_policy.selection: an authorized campaign manager selects and confirms the exact daily budget for every duplicate request
budget_policy.manifest: materialize the confirmed value explicitly in daily_budget minor units; never inherit or guess silently
budget_policy.write_authority: selection does not expand financial authority; actual budget write remains subject to the current Rodolfo/Geizian gate in permissions-matrix
budget_policy.reporting: show manager-selected budget in the final summary and confirm it by Meta readback

delivery_policy.canary_exception: PAUSED only when the request explicitly says technical canary and separately approves later activation
delivery_policy.readback: campaign, ad set and every ad must be configured ACTIVE with the exact future start_time before success

intake_questions: Qual campanha ou campanhas você quer duplicar?
Qual tipo: exata, com criativos novos ou com troca de página?
Qual budget diário de cada duplicação?
No modo com criativos novos: quais assets e copy usar?
No modo troca de página: qual Page, pg_XXXXX, UTM e JSON Messenger completos?
Existe alguma exceção à cópia exata de público, placements, estratégia ou tracking?
question_policy: ask only missing fields; keep questions short; multiple source campaigns may share mode, duplicate count and budget only when the manager says so explicitly
execution_gates: live account and source campaign readback
exact source hierarchy and ad count readback
Drive-Meta reservation and pre-stage for clone_prestaged
final human summary and explicit per-request OK

write_policy.recovery: readback first, preserve request and IDs, write only missing or invalid layers, never replay a non-idempotent POST blindly
